hypothesis: Perovskite-based DSSCs can achieve higher efficiency and stability than traditional DSSCs
prediction: Perovskite-based DSSCs with a solid-state electrolyte will have an efficiency of at least 15%
measurement_method: Standard solar cell efficiency measurement protocols (e.g. IEC 60904-1)
falsification_condition: If the efficiency of perovskite-based DSSCs with a solid-state electrolyte is consistently measured to be below 12% in multiple independent experiments, this prediction is falsified.
